text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp may be over now, but my
spirit is
burning hotter than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I know I've gained a lot of strength for
the
autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If I can maintain my current form,
I'm
confident I'll win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
After we return to the academy, I will
maintain my
focus and continue to train
hard!
